test_AgglomerativeClustering: test the AgglomerativeClustering class to perform hierarchical clustering with configurable linkage and connectivity
test_linkage_tree: test the linkage_tree function to build a hierarchical linkage tree from input data and connectivity
test_ward_tree: test the ward_tree function to build a ward linkage tree with optional distance returns
